name: Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct
notes: head_dim is not in config.json and is derived as hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 3072 / 32 = 96. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = num_layers * num_kv_heads * head_dim * 2 * bytes = 32 * 32 * 96 * 2 * 2 = 24576 bytes/token at bf16. This is MHA, not GQA: 32 KV heads means the KV cache is 4x what a GQA-8 variant of the same width would need (32*8*96*2*2 = 98304 would be larger; the point is KV here is 6x the Phi-4 mini value). config.json sets sliding_window 2047 but it is applied only when the serving engine implements Phi-3's block-sparse pattern; a plain full-attention server allocates the full cache regardless, which is the common misreading of this model. FFN intermediate_size is 8192. 32064 vocab, untied embeddings. Official ONNX (microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct-onnx) and GGUF (microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct-gguf) ports both exist, so non-CUDA CPU/NPU serving is practical.
